item.title: Ask Murph to connect an MCP server
item.summary: In your private chat, ask Murph to connect an MCP server and it sends you the page where you add one.
item.details: Ask which MCP servers Murph has, and it names the ones you connected, apart from its own built-in tools. MCP servers never reach group chats.

tryIt.label: Ask about MCP servers
tryIt.prompt: How do I connect an MCP server?
